name: Rice Pilaf
steps: Melt the 2 tablespoons butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the 1 minced shallot and cook 2 minutes.
Stir in the 1 1/4 cups couscous to coat, then add the 2 cups water and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce to low, and cook 18 minutes without lifting the lid.
Remove from heat, rest 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork. Serve warm.
